name: midnight-dust-sweep-harness
description: Deploy generated benchmark circuits to Midnight Preprod and drive the DUST/fullness sweep through a hosted (Arkhia ZKPaas) proof server.
//deps: Use the @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk BARREL package -- it re-exports the facade and all wallet sub-packages through one dependency. Do NOT depend on wallet-sdk-facade directly. The barrel pins compatible sub-package versions; if you override any of them individually you can desync ledger-8 vs ledger-9 and nothing will link.
//overrides: REQUIRED and must EXACTLY MATCH the direct dependency spec above, or npm fails with EOVERRIDE. midnight-js-protocol pins ledger-v8 to exactly 8.1.0 while the wallet SDK asks ^8.1.0 (=8.1.1); two copies then coexist and their WASM classes are nominally incompatible, breaking WalletProvider/MidnightProvider. Verify with: find node_modules -type d -name ledger-v8 (must print ONE path).
//wallet-sdk-version: PIN TO THE 1.x LINE. Do NOT upgrade to @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk@2.0.0-beta.2: (1) wallet-sdk-facade@5.0.0-beta.2 imports Clock from wallet-sdk-utilities but does not declare that package as a dependency, so the import fails at runtime even on a clean install; (2) the beta moved to @midnightntwrk/ledger-v9, which cannot coexist with midnight-js v4's ledger-v8 pin.
